cases.detail: weight 0 < quorum 5 -> tecXCHAIN_CLAIM_NO_QUORUM
cases.label: single attestation, no quorum

cases.detail: 3 distinct signers, weight 2+2+1=5 >= quorum 5 -> quorum, 3 reward accounts
cases.label: three distinct signers reach quorum

cases.detail: same signer attests twice -> still 1 entry, weight 2 < 5, no quorum
cases.label: replayed attestation does not double-count

cases.detail: re-attestation with larger amount replaces old one (set stays 1), weight still 2
cases.label: re-attestation with larger amount replaces

cases.detail: non-signer attestation rejected (tecNO_PERMISSION) and erased before quorum math
cases.label: non-signer attestation rejected and erased

cases.detail: dst mismatch: excluded on add-attestation path, ignored on claim path
cases.label: destination checked on add, ignored on claim

cases.detail: signer removed from list -> its attestation erased, weight 4 < 5, no quorum
cases.label: removed signer attestation erased

cases.detail: weighted quorum: 2+2=4 no quorum, +1 = 5 quorum
cases.label: weighted quorum boundary

cases.detail: 0 attestations -> tecXCHAIN_CLAIM_NO_QUORUM
cases.label: empty attestation set

cases.detail: weight 4 = quorum-1 -> no quorum
cases.label: weight one below quorum

cases.detail: weight exactly 5 = quorum -> quorum (weight >= quorum)
cases.label: weight exactly quorum

cases.detail: weight 9 > quorum 5 -> quorum, reward accounts = the 3 attesters
cases.label: weight above quorum, rewards listed

cases.detail: attestations for 1,000,000 do not match a claim for 2,000,000 -> no quorum
cases.label: amount mismatch blocks claim

cases.detail: locking-send attestations do not match an issuing-send claim -> no quorum
cases.label: chain-direction mismatch blocks claim

cases.detail: claim ids advance 1,2,3; counter at 2^32-1 wraps to 0 -> tecINTERNAL
cases.label: claim-id counter advances, overflow guarded

cases.detail: equal door accounts -> temXCHAIN_EQUAL_DOOR_ACCOUNTS
cases.label: equal door accounts rejected

cases.detail: submitter is neither door -> temXCHAIN_BRIDGE_NONDOOR_OWNER
cases.label: non-door submitter rejected

cases.detail: locking XRP vs issuing IOU -> temXCHAIN_BRIDGE_BAD_ISSUES
cases.label: mixed XRP/IOU issues rejected

cases.detail: negative reward and non-XRP reward -> temXCHAIN_BRIDGE_BAD_REWARD_AMOUNT
cases.label: bad signature reward rejected

cases.detail: non-XRP and zero min-account-create amount -> temXCHAIN_BRIDGE_BAD_MIN_ACCOUNT_CREATE_AMOUNT
cases.label: bad min-account-create amount rejected

cases.detail: XRP issuing door that is not the root account -> temXCHAIN_BRIDGE_BAD_ISSUES
cases.label: non-root XRP issuing door rejected

cases.detail: locking door locking its own asset -> temXCHAIN_BRIDGE_BAD_ISSUES
cases.label: self-locking door rejected

cases.detail: attestation with unknown public-key type -> temMALFORMED
cases.label: bad public-key type rejected

cases.detail: zero amount, wrong issue, bad signature -> temXCHAIN_BAD_PROOF
cases.label: bad attestation proof rejected
